properties.name: easydebug.url
properties.description: Collector base URL. Blank disables capture. Example: http://127.0.0.1:8090.

properties.name: easydebug.service
properties.description: Service name stored on every event. Defaults to spring.application.name.

properties.name: easydebug.max-body-bytes
properties.description: Prefix of each body kept on the event. Size and SHA-256 still cover the full bytes.

properties.name: easydebug.queue-capacity
properties.description: In-memory queue size. Overflow is reported as a capture.gap event.

properties.name: easydebug.spool-memory-bytes
properties.description: Body bytes kept in memory before spilling to a temp file.

properties.name: easydebug.exclude-paths
properties.description: Comma-separated request path prefixes to skip. Blank means none.

properties.name: easydebug.exclude-hosts
properties.description: Comma-separated hosts to skip. Blank means none.

properties.name: easydebug.redact-headers
properties.description: Header names whose values are stored as [redacted]. Blank stores the raw values.

properties.name: easydebug.redact-query
properties.description: Query parameter names whose values are stored as [redacted]. Blank stores the raw values.

properties.name: easydebug.correlation-keys
properties.description: MDC or header names copied into the correlation field. The full MDC is always stored.
